title: AbsorbEvo: An Agentic Framework for Autonomous Inverse Design of Microwave Absorbers
abstract: arXiv:2610.01119v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Designing high-performance microwave absorbers requires specialized expertise in electromagnetic theory, materials science and simulation programming, and entails time-consuming optimization. Here, we present AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework for autonomous inverse design that translates natural-language performance objectives into designs verified by full-wave simulations. Its candidate evolution strategy integrates language reasoning, physics-based prediction and historical feedback. A large language model proposes the directions and magnitudes of parameter adjustments based on task objectives and computational history. The system combines directed increments with global sampling to generate candidates and uses a low-cost predictive model as a physics prior to rank them. Only high-ranking designs undergo full-wave simulation. Results passing physical validity checks are used to evaluate performance and guide subsequent search. Experience

translated_title: AbsorbEvo：一个用于微波吸收体自主逆向设计的智能体框架
translated_abstract: 设计高性能微波吸收体需要电磁理论、材料科学和仿真编程方面的专业知识，并且涉及耗时的优化过程。在此，我们提出了 AbsorbEvo，这是一个用于自主逆向设计的智能体框架，能够将自然语言形式的性能目标转化为经过全波仿真验证的设计方案。其候选方案演化策略集成了语言推理、基于物理的预测和历史反馈。大语言模型根据任务目标和计算历史提出参数调整的方向和幅度。系统将有向增量与全局采样相结合来生成候选方案，并使用低成本预测模型作为物理先验对其进行排序。只有排名靠前的设计才会进行全波仿真。通过物理有效性检查的结果被用于评估性能并指导后续搜索。
tldr: 本文提出AbsorbEvo智能体框架，利用大语言模型结合低成本物理预测先验与历史反馈，将自然语言性能目标自主转化为经全波仿真验证的微波吸收体设计方案。
en_tdlr: This paper presents AbsorbEvo, an agentic framework that leverages a large language model combined with low-cost physics-based prediction priors and historical feedback to autonomously translate natural-language performance objectives into microwave absorber designs verified by full-wave simulations.
